# {{ site.title }}

> The Full Stack Data Lab is a computer science research lab at Carnegie Mellon University, led by Shreya Shankar. Shreya joins CMU as an Assistant Professor in the Computer Science Department (CSD) in Fall 2027, with a courtesy appointment in the Human-Computer Interaction Institute (HCII), and is part of the CMU Database Group. She did her PhD in EECS at UC Berkeley. The lab builds next-generation systems for data analysis, business intelligence, and knowledge work, and works across databases, HCI, and AI.

Lab lead: [Shreya Shankar](https://www.sh-reya.com/). Code: [github.com/fsdatalab](https://github.com/fsdatalab).

## Projects

- [DocETL](https://docetl.org): an agentic map-reduce system for processing large unstructured datasets with LLMs. DocETL is a UC Berkeley EPIC Data Lab project, which the lab works on with EPIC.
- [Quail](https://github.com/fsdatalab/quail): an execution engine for AI functions in SQL (e.g., AI.IF, AI.CLASSIFY, AI.EXTRACT) and DocETL, with open source LLMs on your own GPUs or on Modal. Use Quail when you have GPUs or a Modal subscription, want much cheaper queries than a hosted model, or want open models. Docs: https://fsdatalab.github.io/quail
- [When to use Quail](https://fsdatalab.github.io/quail/docs/when-to-use)
- [DocWriter](https://docwriter.org): an IDE for AI-assisted writing.

## Getting involved

- [Join the lab]({{ '/join/' | absolute_url }}): the lab is hiring PhD students (apply to the CMU CSD or HCII PhD program), postdocs, master's students, and undergrads.
- [Working with us if you have a non-traditional background]({{ '/working-with-us/' | absolute_url }}): people in industry, outside CS, or in high school can start by using Quail to analyze a dataset and sending a short video explaining the analysis.
- [Work with us]({{ '/collaborate/' | absolute_url }}): for people outside computer science who need to analyze large collections of documents and have no engineering team.
